div.head: Cn 1018
div.ab: And witena gerædnes is. þæt man cristene men for ealles to litlum huru to deaðe ne forræde. ac elles geræde man friðlice steora folce to ðearfe. 7 ne forspille. for litlum godes handgeweorc. 7 his agenne ceap. þe he deore gebohte.

And the decree of the councillors is that Christian men be not condemned to death at least for very trivial offences, but rather that lesser punishments be decreed for the benefit of the people, and the handiwork of God and what he dearly bought for himself be not destroyed for trivial offences.
